csv_project_name: Consultant for Pitt County ADA Transition Plan
csv_scope_of_work: Pitt County is soliciting proposals from qualified consulting firms to assist with the development of an Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Transition Plan. The purpose of this project is to evaluate existing facilities, programs, services, and public rights-of-way for compliance with ADA requirements and to develop a comprehensive plan for achieving compliance
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Consultant for Pitt County ADA Transition Plan
short_description: Consulting services for an ADA compliance transition plan for county facilities and rights-of-way.
project_scope: Development of an Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Transition Plan for Pitt County, including evaluation of existing facilities, programs, services, and public rights-of-way for ADA compliance and preparation of a comprehensive compliance plan.
services: Consulting services for ADA assessment, planning, and transition plan development; disciplines requested include housing and urban development, land use planning, planning/master planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning/assessment assignment without structural or engineering design scope.
- Focus is ADA compliance evaluation of facilities, services, and public rights-of-way.
- No bridge, building, roof, special structure, or sports structure design component identified.
- Falls close to urban/open space planning and consulting, which are not target areas for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction works or construction budget stated in the tender documents. The notice concerns consulting and planning for an ADA transition plan only; no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As the notice is for general ADA planning and compliance consulting rather than structural engineering services, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms are requested; no specific reference counts or technical qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: Pitt County, Greenville, North Carolina, USA. Contact: Ken Brann. Phone: 252-902-3190. Fax: 252-832-6311. Email: ken.brann@pittcountync.gov. Website: https://www.pittcountync.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=74
notes: Questions deadline: 05/27/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Although categorized here as Buildings to satisfy the schema, the procurement is primarily an ADA planning/consulting assignment and is not a typical sbp target project.
